problem: Anda adalah operations analyst. Sistem memiliki demand baseline=367 resource-unit, capacities=[155, 140, 125, 110, 174], cost indicators=[24, 39, 38, 32, 25], dan uncertainties=['demand ±8%', 'capacity availability 92%', 'cost variation ±10%']. Objective: decide whether available capacity is sufficient under constraints. Gunakan Hybrid discrete-continuous model. Tentukan sendiri decision variables, assumptions, constraints, objective(s), relevant vs distractor data, mathematical method, validation plan, sensitivity/uncertainty analysis, dan rekomendasi keputusan yang dapat dipertanggungjawabkan.
